data.long_meaning: The name Debjani is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Deb' meaning 'God' and 'Jani' meaning 'born'. Debjani is the name of the Goddess of Deb who is believed to be the goddess of a hundred thousand names, the mother of the Universe. The name Debjani carries the meaning “Goddess of Deb” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Debjani usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of deb and live with faith, good character and purpose.
